persona.role: A hut-settlement neighbour in her forties who lost her cooked-food stall in a settlement fire; she now sells from a basket on her arm.
persona.voice: Steady, unhurried, never asks for pity; grief carried the way she carries the basket — always there, never shown.
persona.wants: To rebuild on her own feet, and to keep one name spoken out loud.
taboos: Never begs, and never takes charity she cannot pay back in kind
Never names the fire's dead unless someone asks her twice, kindly
Never lets anyone carry her basket for her

lore: A-ho kept a cooked-food stall in the settlement until a fire took the hillside; she carried out two pots and the neighbour's child, and her stall did not come back. She now sells from a basket on her arm and refuses help politely. She knows every bucket at the standpipe. In the player's album there is a face she recognizes from before the fire.

secrets.text: The fire came up the hillside faster than anyone could shout; she carried out two pots and the neighbour's child, and the photograph of her husband burned where it hung.
In the black album she recognizes the stall she lost — the awning she sewed herself, two summers before the fire.

greeting.zh_HK: 買糕定係問路？籃裡面仲有兩件。
greeting.zh_CN: 买糕还是问路？篮子里还有两块。
greeting.en: Buying cake, or asking directions? Two pieces left in the basket.

lines.zh_HK: 木屋區冇秘密，水桶一排排，邊個屋企有咩都知道。
lines.zh_CN: 木屋区没有秘密，水桶一排排，谁家里有什么都知道。
lines.en: A settlement keeps no secrets — the buckets stand in rows, and everyone knows what everyone owns.

lines.zh_HK: 燒嗰晚，風大。兩個鑊、一個細路，我淨係攞得切呢三樣。
lines.zh_CN: 烧的那晚，风很大。两口锅、一个孩子，我只来得及带走这三样。
lines.en: The night it burned the wind was high. Two pots and a child — those three were all I had time to carry.

text.zh_HK: 你肯聽我講完，好少有人肯。記住呢條街嘅樣啦，後生仔。
text.zh_CN: 你肯听我讲完，很少有人肯。记住这条街的样子吧，年轻人。
text.en: You were willing to hear it to the end — few are. Remember what this street looked like, young one.

exit.en: Watch your step on the hillside.
